notes: v663 - 'proven, but too small to trade' was wrong, and appearing next to a $15.53 share made that obvious. Two things were mixed up. First, the edge belongs to the PATTERN, not the share: a line like 'Block day + Inst?' fires on shares at 17 cents and at $15, and its recorded edge is one average across all of them. The verdict now says so - 'proven, small pattern edge' - instead of implying the share in front of you cannot be traded. Second, the 0.50% bar is a single figure applied to every share, and what it is meant to cover varies enormously with price: one price step is 2.9% of a 17-cent share but only 0.06% of a $15.53 one, so on the expensive share a 0.30% edge clears the costs several times over. The tooltip now works out the real cost for the share you are looking at and says plainly when the bar is being blunt. The badge decision itself is unchanged - that is the server's, and it is deliberately conservative. Display only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
